examples.japanese: {嫌々|いやいや}⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
{子|こ}ども⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{嫌々|いやいや}⟦{宿題|しゅくだい}→宿題：00812_shukudai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦やった→やる：02980_yaru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{嫌々|いやいや}⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{手伝|てつだ}って→手伝う：00898_tetsudau⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。

notes:
{嫌々|いやいや} is formed by reduplicating ⟦{嫌|いや}→嫌：10232_iya⟧ (unpleasant, unwilling), expressing doing something against one's will.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {嫌々|いやいや} + verb: to do something reluctantly
- {嫌々|いやいや}⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧(⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧): reluctantly, even though unwilling

POSITION IN SENTENCE:
Typically appears before the verb it modifies.

REGISTER: Neutral to slightly informal.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {渋々|しぶしぶ} (reluctantly, hesitantly)
- ⟦{仕方|しかた}なく→仕方ない：11434_shikatanai⟧ (with no choice)
- ⟦{不本意|ふほんい}→不本意：11363_fuhoni⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧ (unwillingly - formal)

WRITING:
Often written in hiragana as いやいや.
